docs.title: ModTemplateTest
docs.text:
Test Repository created using the ModTemplate for Chivalry 2 Unchained (https://github.com/Knutschbert/ModTemplate)

A Chivalry 2 mod built with ArgonSDK.

This is a placeholder page. Replace it with a description of your mod.

docs.title: Overview
docs.text: Describe what your mod does and what makes it fun. Add screenshots or a short video.

docs.title: Installation
docs.text:
1. Install the Chivalry 2 Unchained launcher.
  2. Find ModTemplateTest in the mod list and enable it.

docs.title: Usage
docs.text: Explain any server settings, console commands or game modes the mod adds.

docs.title: Adding more pages
docs.text: Put more Markdown files in the docs/ folder. They show up in the navigation automatically, and Obsidian-style [[wikilinks]] work between them.
